records.speaker: Manuel Almeida
records.context: Manuel recites three stanzas after a battle on Maria's route. Speaker reactions vary by route.
records.source_meaning: Manuel begins the poem with the resemblance between the sea and a mother. Familiar ripples seem to recall a mother's distant heartbeat.
records.localization_note: Use the registered verse and keep the opening quotation, the refrain and the heartbeat image on one page.

records.previous_English: The sea and a mother are so alike. In distant lands, they say, the two may share their sound and written form.
records.english: The sea and a mother are alike. In some lands, they say, both may be written and spoken the same way.
records.speaker: Manuel Almeida
records.context: Manuel recites three stanzas after a battle on Maria's route. Speaker reactions vary by route.
records.source_meaning: The refrain recurs. Manuel has heard that in some lands the two may be written and pronounced alike.
records.localization_note: Use the same refrain and the tentative report about both the written and spoken resemblance.
